nom: Philosophy Purity Made Simple Pore Extractor Clay Mask

avis.texte: This mask smells great and works well without excessive dryness.

avis.titre: I bought this again about a week ago because I know it works
avis.texte: This product is good and gentle on your face, doesn't leave you with dry skin
This is the best mask for a deep clean, leaves skin feeling so smooth

I notice such a difference when I stop using this product! I can't say enough good things about this item. I never write reviews but never want this to be discontinued and noticed all of the stores within my radius are out of stock!! I will continue to purchase online but please don't take this product away!!
I love Philosophy! I use the clay mask at least 2,3 times a week.It helps keep my pores in my T zone clean,from excess oil It's gentle down"t dry my skin out No smell. And is easy to use.

I tried this for the first time after buying it on a deal. I just bought the small travel tube which I believe will last me for a while if I'm mindful about the amount I use at a time. While it works well, it is overpriced so I will not be buying it unless it's on sale.

As someone who has been an active member of the beauty community for 10+ years, I've tried many face masks and none have ever worked as well as this one. This Philosophy mask stands alone - there is such a noticeable difference in my skin after use, far greater than any other mask I've tried (especially the Bubble charcoal mask and the Kielh's rare earth one). My skin is acne-prone, dry and sensitive and this mask has never caused discomfort after use. It does dry fast and tight, but my skin feels so clean ans refreshed after I take it off. And then makeup application is so good the next day. I love this mask so much because I can really really notice the difference in my skin after use - my pores are so much clearer and I feel so clean. It definitely gets all the gunk out of your pores. This mask deserves more mainstream attention and recognition !!!
This is an excellent mask/scrub. I have used it for years and it has definitely cleaned and minimized my pores. It is a bit abrasive, but not more than you would expect from a face scrub.
I see the difference in my pore the second I use it! The black heads actually disappear, even if temporarily, so I know with continued use there will be longterm results

Love how clean the ingredient list is. The whole purity line is best suited for people with very irritable skin. This stuff cools the redness down, I feel my overall skin's temperature lower when using it. The best!

I don't recommend using this product very frequently if you have dry skin as it contains salicylic acid. This product feels like it sucks all the bad stuff out of my skin. A little goes a long way. I mainly focused around the nose area. Make sure to use a super hydrating moisturizer afterwards!

avis.titre: Works great on my combo skin!
avis.texte: I have combination skin that is sensitive and prone to redness but with larger pores on my forehead and around my nose. I also get breakouts from time to time (thanks hormones). I love using this mask whenever I feel like my skin needs a deep clean. It gets the gunk out of my pores and off my face without stripping it or causing my sensitive skin to flare up. Sometimes I use it only on T zone or breakout areas, but I also use it all over as needed. Please never discontinue this fabulous mask!!

I've been using this for 4 years and I'm only on my second tube. I only use this when I notice that the pores in my t-zone are becoming clogged, and this product instantly cleans them out. My pores are minimized and my skin feels softer after just one use, and a little goes a long way.

I love this clay mask. I also love this brand and have been very impressed with their products so far. I love the clay mask. It removes blackheads and dirt from my pores and helps keep my face clear of acne breakouts.

I had a bad acne breakout and tried everything to get rid of them. I forgot i been purchased this so I used it and when I say it cleared my face so good, this is my new favorite product to use and it's gentle on the skin for those who have sensitive skin like myself. Definitely worth the buy.

avis.titre: Everyone needs to try this mask
avis.texte: Ive tried so much skincare and ive never really noticed a huge difference in my skin with a lot of products. This one has saved me so many times from dead skin and clogged pores it literally tightens your face up and leaves your skin feeling so new.
Can see the results after one use. Opens up the pores and gets out stubborn black heads. Will be something I keep on hand for skincare!
This exfoliator is amazing, not too abrasive and leave my skin super smooth.
I've been using every two weeks and I do see an improvement my skin looks and feels so soft I love this mask it helps me with my acne as well I absolutely love it, highly recommend!!

I have been using this 1-2x a week since December 2024, and wow, I am SO glad I tried this. I used to get painful hormonal acne around my chin and jaw a few days before my period. Emphasis on the, "used to"! Even better than the patches I've tried.

this mask was so effective against stubborn blackheads i've had for as long as i can remember. it left my skin feeling clean and definitely minimizes the appearance of blackheads. i only wish it helped shrink/close all of my pores in general, but i honestly can't complain because it is targeted specifically for blemishes!

I am amazed at how this mask dissolves blackheads on my nose. It's very frustrating trying to exfoliate in that area and I'm always worried I'm going to damage my delicate skin, but not with this mask. And also brightens my face after using it. I've always been a fan of clay masks, but this is the only one I've ever tried that really melts the blackheads and makes them disappear.
incredible mask/scrub that deletes my bumpy oily forehead. it works fantastically well on my skin type, and I will forever be a fan.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so good
avis.texte: This is my favorite face mask that I currently own. I leave on for 10 minutes and scrub lightly and my skin is left so clean and refreshed. I recommend everyone to do a face mask weekly to maximize the effects of their beauty routines. This one from Philosophy is excellent.

I bought this mask a few years ago and absolutely loved it. When I saw it was on sale during Black Friday I was super excited and grabbed it again. It still works amazing! It's got a really nice, sort of gritty texture and dries very solid. Removal is easy and is a nice, gentle physical exfoliator. It leaves my skin looking plump and smooth. I would avoid this if you have very sensitive skin as it is a bit fragrant. Other than that, amazing product! I've tried MANY masks and this one is a repurchase for sure.

I've used this as my go-to mask for almost 10 years, and have never felt the need to find something "better." I use it on my entire face once a week, and it's perfect for removing blackheads and dead skin. I wish they sold this in a pack with the cleanser and moisturizer, it's the best trio!!
Warning your skin does purge in the beginning. However, 2 weeks later your skin looks AMAZING!!!
Love this. Like the scent and it dried up fast. Face looks radiance after used
I got the clay mask as a sample. Now, it is my go to several times a week to keep my skin exfoliated. I love how my skin feels after using it. It is a must have!!
I use this product if I have somewhere important to be in a couple days and I look like I'm gonna be having some pimples or whiteheads or blackheads pop up

avis.titre: Blackhead and pore problem finally solved!!!
avis.texte: I came across this mask on the website while looking for a new mask to try out for my pores. I have a problem with big pores on my cheeks next to my nose, on my nose, and on my chin (blackheads too). I read some of the reviews and they seemed good so I thought I would give it a try (despite the horrifying price). OH.MY.Gosh, this mask is the absolute best thing I have ever used on my face! I have tried numerous expensive brands to help with the pores and blackheads on my face and nothing even comes a bit close to this amazing stuff! I had a blackhead on the bridge of my nose that I just could NOT get rid of, along with the blackheads on my chin. This mask eliminated it with the FIRST use. I have never seen my face so free of blackheads AND smaller pores. I am so amazed, this stuff is magic. If it can do that in one use, I can't imagine what it can do using it over time. I also really love that it is exfoliating, I get such a nice clean refreshed feeling after using this stuff. Also the smell is so good. I have never bought a product that delivered this much on it's claims. If you have trouble with pores and blackheads, this is it.. This is the product that you have been needing. Yes it is on the pricey side, but having beautiful clear skin is priceless. I will be stocking up on this, it's a miracle worker. Thank you Philosophy!!!

i got a sample of this when i got my last ulta order and i will definitely be purchasing a full size version! i have super sensitive skin that leans on the normal to dry side of things but this mask is great! my only caveats are that i made sure i hadnt exfoliated in a while before using this & i always do a moisturizing mask after using this product. if this product was used to frequently or without a soothing moisturizing mask after i can definitely see how it could get irritating fast. the directions recommend twice weekly use, but i used it about every other week and it was perfect. if you have less sensitive skin or maybe even just oilier skin i could see it making sense for every week or maybe twice a week use but for my skin type this is great as an every other week type of thing (which is about my normal frequency/normal routine i follow for exfoliating for my skin). my only real issue is the tiny amount for the price. still, great product!
This product will clear out your pores better than anything else that I have tried. 100% recommend if you want your face at its best!
love this mask! makes my skin smooth and cleans my pores well. I will be repurchasing!
Really does a great job of clearing pores, especially around the nose area. Does not overdry the skin, either.
I've been using this product for 8 yrs & it's amazing!! Cleared up the blackheads on my nose area & chin..It really works!!

Probably the worst product reaction ive ever had. I thought I was crazy thinking this somehow burned my face until i read some of the other reviews. Broke me out, dried me up, spit me out lol but seriously BEWARE especially if you have dry skin!!

I bought this product to deal with the little blackheads on my nose and it absolutely works! Expectedly, you do need to keep using this product regularly to maintain clear pores, but for something that only needs to sit out your face for ~5 minutes, it's absolutely worth it. However, if I don't let my skin rest after toning it, this product burns a lot when applied. Be careful not to irritate your skin, and if you have sensitive skin, be a bit wary of purchasing.

This made my face very red and itchy for days after using it. I also had a few bumps come up. The packaging and scent is nice, but I would recommend trying a different brand if you have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A pore reducing mask that FINALLY WORKED for me!
avis.texte: I've struggled with large pores all my life - particularly on and around my nose. This product (which I put on in the bath - making for a nice luxurious "spa feel") really works for me. My pores are noticeably reduced for days afterward, and it makes my skin feel super smooth. And I have sensitive skin - so it's hard to find this kind of mask for me. I can't say enough how much I love this mask!

I've tried this mask about five times within the past 3 months and wanted to love it because I love philosophy, but it is way too irritating. the scent is like I'm using a strong lemon scented cleaning product on my face. it is extremely abrasive and drying. It leaves my face red and irritated for about two hours after use, even if I don't scrub when removing. I don't have very dry or sensitive skin at all. it is just a badly made product. it doesn't even clear pores or blackheads much at all, it is just irritating and harsh.

This is one of my favorite masks for really getting my pores deeply cleansed. It smells nice and it's a quick 5 to 10 minute mask and while you wash it off, it exfoliates your skin with the beads. This is my go to twice a week.
Broke me out so bad.cause so many little bumps on my forehead.did not remove blackheads

Im not sure this does anything for my pores, but i feel like applying it exfoliates my skin. And over a long period, it keeps my skin clear. I dont notice any immediate effects & ive used almost the entire tube already

The best face mask! It leaves your face refreshed and clean. I use it twice a week, and I have noticed my pores look smaller, and not as noticeable. I sometimes have sensitive skin, but have never had an issue with this making my face inflamed.
I struggle with large pores that clog easily, I used this once and it literally cleared out all of my pores on the first use. Definitely recommend
my skin is so tight and super soft whenever I use this product.
Great to use on a single pimple , simply apply a tiny bit and leave in overnight.
This mask is the best I've ever used for exfoliation and clearing pores. I use it twice a week as I prepare the shower. It's quick and easy to apply, and rinses off beautifully.
Love this product, been using it for years. My skin looks amazing after and it's quick and easy. Highly recommend this mask.
I have used the product and I was impressed with the results. Thanks
It really works, exfoliates the skin without leaving it too dry. Love the product. I have been using it for years. And I will continue to use it for many more years
I use this almost every day in trouble spots and it definitely helps keep my skin feeling and looking clean and clear!
Cannot live without this in my skin care routine! My skin always feels so smooth and radiant after I use it!
I have sensitive skin, most products, even expensive ones have irritated my skin or made me brake out. This pore cleaner has been amazing for my skin, love it! And it's all I use to deep clean.

avis.titre: I continue to buy this particular mask!
avis.texte: It was recommended to me by an Ulta associate and said it was the one that most of the associates recommended and used as well! My skin feels soft, refreshed, and helps with the various aging issues!
My skin looked noticeably heathier in 2 applications!! I absolutely will be buying this again.

I love using this clay mask. It's made to unclog and exfoliate skin when it's feeling congested and dull. It contains active ingredient Salicylic acid and I just love how clear and smooth my face looks after use.
I rarely get on to rate things, but this makes your face so soft after using.

avis.titre: Great Results in just one week!
avis.texte: I used this twice in the first week and already have noticed significant reduction in clogged nose pores and a reduction of the pore size as well. Just what I was hoping for!
I had small black heads on my nose, and one deep one above my lip. One use and they are gone!
I noticed a change in my skin after using this twice! Immediately recommended to a friend. I absolutely love it and use it twice a week. I love the way my skin feels after I use it. Clean and soft.

My face feels so clean and refreshed after using this mask. I'm prone to whiteheads and blackheads and this really helps to clean the gunk out of my pores. I have dry, slightly sensitive and I haven't had any adverse effects. However, i use this every 2-3 weeks and i feel like any more then that would be too aggressive for my skin.

Ive used this about three times already and every time i use it it gives me such a great result. My skin is glowy and smooth. Love to use it weekly. I like how its applied on dry skin to make the exfoliating more satisfying to see it working
I like the mask. It makes my skin very soft and clean feeling.

I will preface this by saying that i have sensitive skin, so my experience wont be the same as everyones! This product was recommended to me by an employee when i expressed concern over clogged nose pores. When you see a product with "purity" in the name, you might assume it would be good for delicate skin, but it is quite the opposite. The fragrance is very strong. The product itself does a good job at removing dead skin and some live skin too. I would equate it to 120 grit sandpaper. The clay dries quickly and washes off pretty cleanly, but my skin felt like I had witnessed an atom bomb drop nearby, because my skin was so irritated and burning. I applied a double layer of my usual moisturizer, but the damage was done. My skin barrier was toast. Its been over a week and I'm still recovering. Sensitive skin folks BEWARE!

Ive struggled for the past 7 years to find skin care products that legitimately work for my skin. Ive tried ProActiv, Curology, Clinique, and more but this brand is by far my favorite. This mask makes me want to try everything else Philosophy has to offer. And btw, this IS a real review! This is the first Philosophy product I've tried and will definitely be buying more.

I've used this for years and it has truly made a difference in my pores post usage!! I have oily to combination skin and this worked great! And had a good gritty texture to help exfoliate when washing off

This product works as it claims to. With several applications, my skin glowed, the pores were smaller and oil free. It does not, however, dry your skin out that much. Very good balance of doing what it should, but not harshly.
I have been using this mask for a couple of years- I appreciate that I don't need to use a ton of product, it works quickly and my skin looks & feels amazing & ready to moisturize
Cleared my acne so quickly, love this product. Didn't burn either

I love it , i have acne prone skin and very delicate. Its been amazing, my pores are gone with this and my skin feels so smooth. I legit want the days to pass to do again my skincare with this product i recommend it to everyone
I have been using this facial mask for about four months and this really helps replenish all the good nutrients your skin needs, it is a true must.
I have combo skin and this is a holy grail. I use it twice a week and my complexion is so much smoother and even
This mask is a keeper, it really helps with my problematic skin…. Leaves skin soft, black heads and pores seem to disappear after use.

I am an oily girl with huge pores. They never seem to be clear. Even when I have no "breakouts", my pores are still clogged and you can see blackheads. This mask made my skin look SO good after one use. Now it is a bit rough, so sensitive skinned friends, may want to use with caution. But for me, it is a holy grail.

I use this mask weekly (use purity made simple face wash daily!) and absolutely love it. It tightens up and deep cleans my pores and feels like it polishes off dead skin without overly drying me out or over exfoliating.
I've been using this product for a month now and it is Great... My pores are starting to shrink and I can really tell it's working.

Used this as soon as I got it in the mail on my nose and WOW! About 10 minutes after I put it on, I washed it off and saw all of the things clogging my pores come up to the surface! I saw in another review that they used pore strips, which I HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Once everything was brought to the surface, the pore strips helped fully remove it! This leaves my nose looking like I just left a spa after a facial post-extractions! I saw some reviews saying it left their skin dry, but my skin was fairly soft afterwards!
I've only tried it once so far but I loved it. My face felt so smooth and clean when I took it off.

avis.titre: Used this for years and love it
avis.texte: Never will stop using this product. Makes me skin feel so refreshed after.

so i don't know how i stubbles across this but i was looking for something for my blackheads and WOW. literally after one use the blackheads on my nose were basically gone and my face feels great. it's not harsh, doesn't burn and is so easy to apply and remover. this is a game changer!
My 1st reactionwas ong this smells so fresh and clean plus lemony. I love how soft my skin feels after each use. I obviously have a obsession with all purity..

avis.titre: The only mask you need for blocked pores.
avis.texte: This mask every 2-3 weeks has nearly eliminated my blackheads and small blocked pores. And, it is gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin. If I forget to use it regularly I NOTICE the difference in the mirror. Simple ingredients, simple mask. It is all you need.

I've always struggled with blackheads and have done years of digging on what to use for clearing up my skin. A couple days ago I came across the philosophy face mask, used it that night, after purchasing it, and noticed my blackheads were virtually almost gone. I did it the next day one more time and my blackheads essentially disappeared 10 out of 10!

I am lazy with skincare so blackheads build up, but this year I committed to taking care of my skin everyday so I started with this and WOW!! Blackheads melted! I know my expensive serums and moisturizer are actually getting into my pores now!

avis.titre: A clay mask that actually works and does what it says!
avis.texte: This mask is OUTSTANDING! I love the fact that this does not irritate my skin, or leave me feeling dry afterwards. I have sensitive skin (a red headed irish girl). As your applying it, it dries quickly, (and a little gos a LONG WAY) so I don't recommend leaving it on longer than 10 minutes. I love using a muslin or bamboo wash cloth, when removing this mask. I also get it wet and use circular motions to exfoliate, while I remove, just like it says you can do in the directions. It helps to oxygenate your skin. I love the way my skin looks after.
This mask seems to work okay. For what it does I would say that it's way expensive and the size of it is super small. Its not worth the price in my opinion.
This mask really works on me. I started having bumpy skin and blackheads. But since I started using this a few times a week all has cleared up. Great product.
Great clay mask, it's very lightweight and hydrating, also skin extremely smooth and nice! You get what you pay for with this mask.
I like it so far, iv noticed a little change. I need more time I think.

I use this once or twice a week and its been amazing. My skin appeared clean and balanced. The clay does dry up instantly, and I would rub it right away or else you have to apply more and more. Overall, its great for clearing pores.

I have struggled with cystic acne and have dry and acne-prone skin. Another huge issue for me is my pores, blackheads, and Sebaceous filaments, which are often confused with blackheads. After using this for the second time, I noticed a significant difference in my pores and especially my nose. This product has minimized the appearance of my pores and my skin looks and feels so much cleaner. It leaves your skin feeling soft and you can see the difference right after washing the product off, your skin will literally look like a baby. It's gentle, dries quick but make sure you leave it on for a max of 10 mins, if exfoliates, it foams, and it has small beads that won't clog your pores like that grapefruit face wash. I would definitely recommend, I just wish you would get more for the price!
I use this clay mask at least twice a week and I've really noticed a difference in the white heads and pores on my face disappearing. It leaves your skin feeling so smooth and clean. Very satisfying!
I use it once a week just on my t-line on face. I leave it on for about an hour and I notice my pores look smaller.

Philosophy products are known for their unique scents, and it's no different with their Purity Made Simple. I'm not exactly sure what a pearl would smell like, but it's as if Philosophy perfected and pioneered the scent of luxurious pearls!

I makes my skin feel amazing and SO clean!!! And made ALL my acne away!! Not kidding it solved my skin problem!! It made all my acne go away and all the grease and oils go away!!! I have only skin and it helped everything!!! It also helps with teen/tween skin!

Hello, Holy grail. This stuff is crazy good. Don't leave it on too long. 10 minutes max. When you go to wash it off it turns in and exfoliates. Leaves my skin looking glowy and youthful. I have oily skin by the way. Every time I use this mask I look so youthful. Yes, buy this!

I like this is like three in one product: scrub, clay mask, and acne treatment. I like the beads that gently and deeply removes dead skin. I like how I can let it dry and then remove it. And acne treatment is a nice bonus. This is a nice product to use as part of my nighttime skincare routine. I will apply this and then jump in the shower to remove it. My skin feels soft and deep cleaned after using this.

I got this clay mask as a gift a little while ago and I use it all the time! I have a tough time finding skin care that works for my skin and I was pleasantly surprised with how nice it works for me! It leaves my face smooth and soft as well as helped clear up imperfections! Will for sure keep purchasing every time I run out!

This mask feels like it gives a deep clean for your face with mild exfoliation. It works really well on oily areas and for breakouts. It has a citrus type of scent but has not irritated my skin. It also didn't cause excessive dryness or flaky skin.

I got this because I had these tiny blackheads on my nose. I was thinking it probably wouldn't work much. By the third use I not only noticed that the blackheads were clearing but my face was looking really smooth. It does say that it minimizes the appearance of pores, so I suppose that's why. It does dry out your face though, so make sure to use your moisturizer afterwards.
I received this in a box. I used it immediately and loved it, I looked for the full size bottle after that. It's creamy and light at the same time.
I love this product. I got it as a free sample for purchasing the day and night moisturizers and it is awesome! I keep it in the shower and use often and it makes my skin feel smooth and radiant.
This is the best cleaning clay mask I have ever had! Just once a week, my face naturally grows to brighten. This is incredibly unexpected!

I was lucky to not have many skin problems, however my husband has hereditary cyst. I have brought him home millions of products. Nothing was working until this. He puts it on at night and come morning it's dried out and on it's way to healing. It works great for blemishes as well.
I use this for blackheads/ sebaceous filaments and it makes them disappear! Pricey but it lasts forever. Staple in my skincare

avis.titre: It's the only thing that works for my cystic acne!
avis.texte: I have tried numerous products and prescriptions - but this is the only product that stops my cystic acne in it's tracks! If I feel anything starting up - I start using this mask - and it stops the acne before it can get a foothold.

I am amazed at the effectiveness of this mask! I have been struggling with some very serious congestion, and didn't expect anything to work, but this mask really does clear pores. Importantly, it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I will definitely keep using it.
Had it sent to me to try and it was OK. Felt nice but I think I would have to use it more to see if it does what it says

avis.titre: it's okay, don't see the hype
avis.texte: this is a nice mask, do not get me wrong. but I genuinely do not see any improvement after using it besides exfoliation. it smells a bit like paint. i love philosophy products so it's kind of a bummer, plus it leaves my skin dry and tight. the only upside really is that it exfoliates a decent amount of dead skin off. i wish i'd have bought the trial size before committing to a full tube, i don't think i'll be repurchasing
I like the way this product makes your face feel soft and fresh. Definitely was a life saver on my trip! Unfortunately I only purchase the traveling size but will definitely purchase for daily use.

avis.titre: Almost 50 and skin like a 14 year old
avis.texte: Acne flair ups , irritated skin ... this helps. I use this mask twice a week and it has calmed the breakouts and makes my complexion feel and look fresh and bright.

I'm someone who struggles with blackheads around my nose, on my chin, and between my eyebrows. I use this product maybe one time per week. It leaves my skin looking a lot healthier and cleaner. I would also say it's slightly exfoliating.
Love the intensity with which it pulls out the oils as it dries out.
Mehhhh not a fan. For whatever reason this made my skin purge so sadly this was a no for me. I know a lot of people who swear by this but not for sensitive skin
This was an okay product. I liked it intiAlly but found myself not using it much after a few tries. I can't really tell if this ever did anything for me.
Good product but it's too expensive for all the days. I don't buy it anymore. The pack is ok and useful for the holidays
I like that this cleaner didn't strip my face like many pure clearing or extracting products. My face was really clean but didn't have that tight or irritated effect.

Love this product…I have Uber sensitive skin so I can't use a lot of face cleaner products this was suggested to me so I tried it thinking I probably will set off my sensitive skin but no it didn't happen, my skin felt so healthy after using it I highly recommend this.
This mask was ok. It left my skin feeling so so smooth but didn't show much improvement on my skin after many uses. I think there are better masks out there.

I love using this mask before going to an important event. When I use it consistently I always get compliments on my skin. Cleans pores & leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed. I love the tight feeling of the mask as it dries.

My daughter has sensitive skin and she loves this product! She prefers the combination product properties: The clay cleans her pores; once the clay dries, she adds water to her hands and then gently exfoliates her face.

avis.titre: You have to try it!! To believe it!!
avis.texte: You only have to look at the awards this product has won to know that a goody. It sucks out all of the oil and dirt which gets stuck in our pores, that dirt and grime is absaloutley unavoidable, bits of dust in the air you cannot avoid so we need something to keep those pores clean. This is exactly what you need.
Philosophy purity made simple pore extractor mask is perfect for T zone. The black head acne is gone after few times using.
I have fairly sensitive skin but never have any breakouts or any signs of distress to my skin after using this poor extractor mask!

This stuff is great. You use it after you wash and dry your face and it scrubs all the dead skin off! I tend to have sensitive skin and as long as I don't scrub my face too long it doesn't make me sensitive! 10/10 and I have an unopened bottle under my sink so I never run out
has anyone tried this? i want to reduce my pores as i suffer with acne and large pores i was wondering if this is any good?

What a difference after one application; my skin feels refreshed and has a youthful glow. Followed with moisturizer and makeup routine. Will continue to use twice weekly to maintain this rejuvenated look.
This mask will give instant results for softer smoother skin. One star taken Off since the clay can be over drying. Just be sure to followup with a good moisturizer.
Works great, skin feels amazing after ! Have been using for a couple years

This is amazing! I always used those "face/nose strips" and they never worked like this product. It says you will see results in 2 try's but I used it once so far and it is so smooth. When you see your pores actually getting extracted, it's a relief. You don't even need to use a lot! Must buy!
I use this every Sunday for self care Sunday! Gets rid of all the congestion from the week. Highly recommend this will become a staple for you too!
I like how this clears my pores from the dirt and oils of a long day. This mask is refreshing and it has little beads for the scrubbing action so you feel like it's really doing all the work.
I have extremely oily, textured skin. This mask is truly exceptional. It helps with excessive oil and texture. Its gentle. I will always have this in my arsenal.

avis.titre: Clears all my troubles spots nose forehead and my chin area
avis.texte: Best mask I've used in awhile I have combo oily skin hyperpigmentation and this does wonders for my skin I Recommend to anyone 🙌🏾
Great for purging black heads and just clearing the gunk away.

This is the best product I've ever used to get rid of blackheads. It leaves my skin smooth and deep cleaned, with a noticeable reduction in pore size. I use once a week to tide me over till my next professional facial and it keeps my breakouts at bay. I have sensitive skin so I apply gently in the shower, let it sit for 3 min and rinse off. It is very powerfully exfoliating so don't rub too hard. I follow with a cooling phyto mask.
